scenario: A seller's listing agent uses an agent pipeline to prepare the legally required state seller disclosure form for a residential property. State law requires sellers to disclose all known material defects including prior flooding, foundation issues, unpermitted additions, and roof-age issues. The pipeline extracts prior homeowner records and inspection history from PDFs, normalizes the findings against the statutory disclosure checklist, and produces a completed state-form disclosure document for the seller's signature.
info_flow: pdf-extract pulls raw text from inspection reports and homeowner records → presale-regulation-auditor maps each finding to the statutory disclosure checklist categories and produces a normalized findings JSON → legaldoc-ai assembles the completed state seller disclosure form using the normalized findings as source data.
